title: LegendaryPerks catalog
description: Tells Tales which perk and which value global belong to each rank of each legendary perk card.
x-help:
Legendary perks are the 28 cards Tales runs itself (Ammo Factory, Funky Duds, Legendary Strength and so on), each with four ranks. For every rank Tales needs two forms: the PERK that is added to the player, and a GLOB that holds the rank's strength.

Each binding is named B21_Legendary_<Card>_<rank> for the perk, or B21_Legendary_<Card>_<rank>_Value for its global, where the rank is 1 to 4 and the card is one of the names in the card list, for example B21_Legendary_FunkyDuds_2 or B21_Legendary_FunkyDuds_2_Value.

The conversion writes all 112 perk bindings and their globals. You only need this catalog to point a rank at your own perk or value, or to remove a binding an earlier plugin made.

Cards: AmmoFactory, BloodSacrifice, BrawlingChemist, CollateralDamage, DetonationContagion, ElectricAbsorption, ExplodingPalm, FarFlungFireworks, FollowThrough, FunkyDuds, HackAndSlash, LegendaryAgility, LegendaryCharisma, LegendaryEndurance, LegendaryIntelligence, LegendaryLuck, LegendaryPerception, LegendaryStrength, MasterInfiltrator, PowerArmorReboot, PowerSprinter, Retribution, SizzlingStyle, SurvivalShortcut, TakingOneForTheTeam, WhatRads, ActionDiet, FeralRage.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Perk and value-global bindings. The name says which card and rank; the value is the form. A later plugin's binding replaces an earlier one.
